scope: Real element-plus-secondary ElSelectV2 presentation and keyboard interaction for an already selected C option.

options.label: C — 当前值不在可用选项中

oracle: The closed select displays the invalid C label while retaining C as modelValue.
The select input exposes role=combobox, aria-haspopup=listbox, and an expanded state when opened.
The C row is rendered disabled and remains identifiable as the selected value.
Click/keyboard interaction cannot newly select C while it is disabled; any broader listbox/option role gap is recorded as an accessibility limitation rather than hidden.
The closed select displays the unverified C label while retaining C as modelValue.
The C row remains rendered disabled and the status text is exposed in the rendered label.

non_goals: No real enum API, authorization, revocation, persistence, or dashboard save/reopen behavior.
No claim of full screen-reader conformance or product acceptance.
